title: [Issue]: Unable to cache `ParsedChatCompletion` Objects in OpenAIWrapper
body:
### Describe the issue

With the introduction of the new structured output, the OpenAI client calls the `client.beta.chat.completions.parse` method, which returns [`ParsedChatCompletion`](https://github.com/openai/openai-python/blob/main/src/openai/types/chat/parsed_chat_completion.py#L35) objects. These objects cannot be pickled, which poses a problem for caching responses. 

### Steps to reproduce

_No response_

### Screenshots and logs

_No response_

### Additional Information

We could convert the `ParsedChatCompletion` objects into [`ChatCompletion`](https://github.com/openai/openai-python/blob/6974a981aec1814b5abba429a8ea21be9ac58538/src/openai/types/chat/chat_completion.py#L43) objects before storing them. The `ChatCompletion` objects are picklable superclass of `ParsedChatCompletion` which contain all the fields that we use from the response in the client, so this approach would enable seamless caching while maintaining the structured output's benefits.

linked_prs.title: Add conversion from ParsedChatCompletion to ChatCompletion
linked_prs.body:

## Why are these changes needed?

This PR introduces a `_convert_to_chat_completion` method that will convert `ParsedChatCompletion` objects into `ChatCompletion` objects. The `ChatCompletion` objects are picklable superclass of `ParsedChatCompletion` which contain all the fields that we use from the response in the client, so this approach enables caching of the responses generated while using `response_format` option.

## Related issue number

Closes #133

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves handling and caching `ParsedChatCompletion` objects returned by the OpenAI client, which directly relates to LLM provider integration and memory mechanisms, specifically memory content errors (inability to store responses due to pickling issues).
